prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Paper and Carmine: page #FFFFFF, text #202020, accent #AF173B, secondary surface #F0F2F2, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 14px, heading 28px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 8px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
